title: New Austin Leadership Sworn In
summary:
*   Newly elected City Council members for Place One, Three, and Four — Goodman, Griffith, and Slusher — officially took their oaths of office.
*   Council Member Goodman was reelected to serve as the Mayor Pro Tem.
*   The meeting was a brief, special-called session, lasting less than an hour and focused solely on these organizational changes.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL-CALLED MEETING
June 15,1999
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order at 7:57 p.m. Council Members Garcia and Spelman
were absent.
(1)
Administer the oath of office to the newly elected Council Members for Place One, Place
Three, and Place Four of the City Council.
The Honorable Judge Orlinda Naranjo, Travis County Court-at-law No. 2 administered the
oath of office to Council Members Goodman, Griffith and Slusher.
(2)
Select Mayor Pro Tern.
A motion was made to reelect Council Member Goodman as Mayor Pro Tern on Council Member
Griffith's motion, Council Member Slusher's second by a 5-0 vote. Council Members Garcia
and Spelman were absent.
(3) Adjourned at 8:40 p.m. on Council Member Slusher's motion, Council Member Lewis'
second by a 5-0 vote. Council Members Garcia and Spelman were absent.
The minutes for the Special Called Meeting of June 15,1999 and the minutes for the Regular
Meeting of July 1, 1999 were approved on this the 15th day of July, 1999 on Council Member
Slusher's motion, Mayor Watson's second by a 4-0 vote. Mayor Pro Tern Goodman and Council
Member Griffith were off the dais. Council Member Garcia was absent.
